items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Nelson Riddle would pick his band and keep them there all the time, like Tommy, the trombone player -- he was first trombone when I was there met-him; I was playing the third trombone.

ctx.x: Who else was in that band? Was it all studio musicians or was there anybody else who had a name?

Well, I don't know. What's the name? Nelson Riddle would pick his band and keep them there all the time, like Tommy, the trombone player -- he was first trombone when I was there met-him; I was playing the third trombone.
